title: pr-flow: admitted opener withdrawal becomes unsettled after an unrelated push
body:
## Owning canonical reader gap observed after a verified native withdrawal

Observed with canonical main `4b4f48dae1b804b2581974e604cca618ecedadf1`; the installed skill pack matches that reviewed source. This issue records the blocker and asks for an owning policy decision/repair. It does not authorize a local bypass or transfer review approval.

### Native sequence

1. [Rheos PR9](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/9) was at `9b753377a6e7edcd858942d9aecc04c44b8cb108`, base `660a6f880769edcf9e52cc5e21e477a5545133f8`.
2. CodeRabbit review `5461949384` opened Major finding [`4223364089`](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/9#discussion_r4223364089), thread `PRRT_kwDOU4Vf-c6qhjvo`. The suggestion was to substitute loader-derived display identity when a card lacked its stored UUID. The accepted relationship law requires stored identity and refuses inference or ambiguous/missing identity.
3. The native opener [withdrew the finding in `4223418686`](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/9#discussion_r4223418686) with the recognized live sentence, substantive rationale and source links. A bound User writer [Handled reply `4223433046`](https://github.com/riatzukiza/rheos/pull/9#discussion_r4223433046) was admitted by the canonical settle command at that same head; the opener subsequently confirmed it. The complete native thread was resolved and not outdated.
4. Two ordinary owned commits advanced the head to `28b2a9bf11e98b86628f3f5cf75ebbb0adbfab72`: repair a real writer-reservation directory discovery race, and clarify the edit-result docstring while preserving raw review evidence. The missing-stored-UUID refusal remains implemented and its new negative test passes. No inferred identity fallback was added.
5. Canonical status at the new head reports `1 P0/P1 thread(s) not fixed` despite the retained resolved native withdrawal. The separate traversal finding is Fixed-settled on the new head. Fresh deterministic checks pass; the new full review remains in progress/rate limited and supplies no approval yet.

### Exact source cause

[`opener-withdrawal`](https://github.com/riatzukiza/.agents/blob/4b4f48dae1b804b2581974e604cca618ecedadf1/skills/pr-flow/scripts/pr_flow/law.cljc#L323) requires the root enclosing review commit, withdrawal enclosing review commit and Handled reply enclosing review commit all to equal the current PR head. Their actual immutable native review commits remain `9b753377...`. Reposting a current writer explanation or requesting a new confirmation cannot make the original root review commit equal `28b2a9bf...`.

A fresh native GraphQL read on October8 at20:08:57UTC bound PR head/base, all2 threads and complete comment counts/pageInfo. Its unmodified JSON is3374bytes/SHA256 `e1a91fc500710ea1cec0422e60e9286d19b5db23fa549fcd3ec04f0701556274`. The Major thread has5 native comments; root, withdrawal and original Handled enclosing commits all remain the old head. This source is retained privately and in the owning append-only evidence handoff. The historical native withdrawal is not a synthetic APPROVED review or independent rejection assessment.

### Requested owning resolution

Clarify the supported path for a previously admitted opener withdrawal after an unrelated push. A repair, if selected and reviewed, must preserve original finding severity, immutable root/review/source IDs, original head, full conversation and subsequent pushback/revocation history. Any current disposition must independently verify the premise against current source. Stale or conflicting evidence must remain blocked. Current exact-head approvals, complete input, available-agent convergence and required checks remain separate obligations.

The alternative independent rejection route still requires a supported authenticated non-CodeRabbit native agreement on the current head. A pasted transcript, generic approval body or author self-agreement cannot fill it. The selected eta-mu receiver prerequisite is not yet implemented.

This newly discovered prerequisite blocks qualification of the writer needed by the accepted Cephalon loop slice. Record it explicitly for scope adjudication; do not silently enlarge the finite milestone, change application code to satisfy an invalid finding, or weaken the canonical gate. No proposed local classifier, waiver, identity alias, paid credits or production changes are part of this issue.
